script: These particular things are stuck, and I can't unstick them.

props.description: Against a near-black background, handwritten words drift in one at a time — 'twinkling eyes', 'ebony hair', 'enlightening smile' — each glowing faintly amber, orbiting an invisible center as if held by gravity. They don't fall away. After 4 seconds, a single line fades in at the bottom in thin serif: 'Some people just stay.' Mood: haunted, intimate, irreversible. Niche: poetry.
